pairs.why: The real card is a dark, low-key magenta-purple with dark corners and a spotlight glow behind the kit. B has darker purple corners and a glow behind the hero, while A is a flatter, brighter pink with even rays.
B's larger, darker posts and deeper water value at the bottom match the real card's strong dark accents better than A's small, airy, high-key dock.
B's darker navy truss and housing sit closer to the real card's dark hero. Both backgrounds are far brighter than the real card's dim teal.
A's soft orange gradient, with the hero sitting in a gentle light-to-dark falloff, is nearer the real card's smooth glow. B has a hard floor/wall split.
A has a darker hedge and a slightly deeper hero base, which is a little closer to the real card's darker green key. Both are much brighter than the real card.
Both show a bright cyan striped background with hero values and stripe contrast almost identical, so there is no value-based reason to choose.
A's warm, bright sand and background glow with a soft dark shadow under the ball match the real card's key. B's grainy, darker sand dulls the background.
B's deeper blue wall gives the red gloves a stronger value separation, like the real card's dark blue. A's wall is lighter cyan and higher key.
